retention_policy: Move only the exact original failed directory once, on the same filesystem, to runtime/native_repeat_retry_v1/<region>/attempt.XXXXXX/preserved_failed_run. Preserve every byte, path, mode and empty directory; preserve original relative paths and resolve them using the recorded mapping. No deletion or model-quality analysis.
retry_policy: Archive verification must pass before the unchanged native repeat runner may be invoked once. This wrapper never starts a retry. Original failure hashes are the sole admission identities; a later failure is not eligible for another archive/retry under this contract.
cost_policy: Original failed driver duration and memory evidence remain part of resource and reproducibility reporting, separately from the completed retry; never erase failed-attempt cost or equate it with anchor cost.
interpretation: Comparisons of the two completed executions are conditional on completion (completion-conditioning). Preserve original CUDA OOM failures and disclose the one operational retry; this is not unconditional repeat variability, an isolated causal allocator effect, a noise bound, or a scientific verdict.
